overrides.name: lighthouse
overrides.reason: @lhci/cli 0.15.1 and @lhci/utils 0.15.1 pin Lighthouse 12.6.1, which pulls puppeteer-core 24.31.0 and chromium-bidi 11.0.0 with vulnerable Zod 3.25.76. Keep Lighthouse CI runner and select Lighthouse 13.6.0 with Puppeteer 25 to eliminate vulnerable Zod 3 without a Zod major-version override. Revalidate 13.6.0 against Lighthouse thresholds, supported browsers and security scans.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove when a released Lighthouse CI dependency natively selects Lighthouse >=13.5.0 and security, Lighthouse thresholds, browsers and full CI remain green.
